name: Vinh Giang — STAGE Academy
what_it_is: 7-module, 120+ video course by keynote speaker/magician Vinh Giang on voice, stage presence, storytelling, body language, persuasion.
notes: Seed. Known for the 'five vocal foundations' drills (rate, pitch, tonality, volume, pause); reviews describe exercises.

name: Gotham Writers Workshop — Stand-Up Comedy Writing
what_it_is: 10-week online/NYC stand-up comedy writing workshop with lectures, exercises, and critique, ending in an optional club performance.
notes: Workshop syllabus public; explicit weekly exercises.

name: Udemy — Ultimate Joke Writing Guide
what_it_is: Udemy course covering 12 major joke structures with step-by-step writing process.
notes: Curriculum (12 joke structures) visible in course outline — extractable without purchase.

name: Udemy — How to Be Funny in 14 Days
what_it_is: Conversational humor course based on analyzing 1,000+ talk-show clips; patterns and lines for everyday wit.
notes: Directly about conversational wit (not stage comedy); outline public on Udemy.

name: A Funnier You (David Nihill ecosystem)
what_it_is: Humor-for-speakers training (5-minutes-a-day practice) related to David Nihill's FunnyBizz/'Do You Talk Funny?' approach for business humor.
notes: 'Practice 5 minutes a day' page outlines daily humor drills; book has 7 comedy-habits framework.

name: Charisma on Command — Charisma University
what_it_is: Charlie Houpert's 30-day video program (6 modules: first impressions, confidence, expert conversation, storytelling/humor, presence) with daily action steps.
notes: Seed-adjacent. Action-step-per-lesson design; module list public; YouTube channel = 7M subs.

name: Science of People — People School (Vanessa Van Edwards)
what_it_is: Year-long 12-module professional social-skills program: nonverbal communication, rapport, charisma, workplace influence.
notes: Site has huge free exercise-rich blog (e.g., 'how to be funny' steps) — easy extraction.

name: Patrick King (books: The Art of Witty Banter, Improve Your Conversations)
what_it_is: Conversation-coach author of 30+ social-skills books including witty-banter and improv-techniques-for-conversation titles with actionable drills (free association, HPM, SBR).
notes: Books contain named techniques/exercises for wit specifically (HPM/SBR/EDR frameworks) — core extraction source.
